claim_boundary.claim_if_passed: Only that the frozen v0.3 observability surface requalifies the preregistered frozen 48 non-epistemic synthetic cells for A3/A4 execution under the pre-existing truth-independent observability-admission predicate and exact frozen support modules. It does not establish A3/A4 semantic correctness, mutation truth prediction, fresh-target performance, candidate-58 performance, or representation-closure correctness beyond what is explicitly reported.

first_complete_output_rule: Once all 48 selected cells have produced a complete primary and independent requalification output plus canonical cross-check, that first complete bundle is immutable. PASS or FAIL must be archived before any code, adapter, workflow, selection, normalization, or gate change.
next_authorized_step: DERIVE AND FREEZE THE METADATA-ONLY FROZEN-48 SELECTION MANIFEST FROM THE EXACT FROZEN MATRIX. THE SELECTOR MAY SEMANTICALLY CONSUME ONLY CELL IDENTITY AND THE PREEXISTING MUTATION-CLASSIFICATION NEEDED TO DISTINGUISH THE 24 POSITIVE-SEMANTIC-LOSS, 24 SEMANTIC-PRESERVING, AND 10 EPISTEMIC-ADVERSARIAL ROWS. DO NOT READ CELL SOURCE BYTES, CELL TRUTH, OPERATOR METADATA, EXPECTED E2 PREDICTIONS, RAW BLIND-58 TRANSPORT, OR CANDIDATE-58 BYTES.

normalized_cross_check_contract.canonicalization_rule: Cross-check compares named semantic fields after fail-closed canonicalization, never raw implementation-specific container equality. Missing fields, extra semantic alternatives, malformed values, identity mismatch, or canonical semantic disagreement are failures.
normalized_cross_check_contract.checker_independence_claim: Primary and independent adapters must independently compute the admission predicate and canonical row projection but may consume the same frozen v0.3 frontend/IR and same frozen support modules. This is checker-level independence, not independent parser or path-engine implementation.

preexisting_semantics_preserved.representation_closure_note: The historical witness-precondition surface may report representation closure separately. This frozen-48 admission gate does not silently promote an unproven representation-closure condition into a semantic verdict, nor does it waive any later A3 serialization-survival requirement.

purpose: Prospectively requalify the pre-existing held-out 48 non-epistemic synthetic mutation cells against the already-frozen v0.3 candidate-observability remediation without source leakage, post-hoc cell selection, scientific-code modification, semantic-truth consumption, or candidate-58 exposure.

allowed_matrix_semantics: row identity sufficient to identify the frozen cell
pre-existing mutation-classification sufficient to partition rows into positive_semantic_loss, semantic_preserving, epistemic_adversarial
fail_closed_conditions: ambiguous mapping from matrix row to frozen cells-tree entry
selector attempts to consume source content, truth, operator metadata, expected E2 prediction, or candidate transport metadata
selection_protocol.source_identity_rule: After the 48 identities are selected, Git tree metadata may be used to bind their exact source-file Git blobs from cells_tree_git_sha without fetching source contents. No source blob may be opened until the selection manifest is committed and frozen.

allowed_new_code_before_first_48_executi: specialization/cross-check utilities that do not modify scientific semantics
scope_and_minimality.scientific_change_rule: No scientific implementation change is authorized. TypeScript/JavaScript must use exact frontend_js_v3; Python must use exact frontend_python_v2; IR routing must use exact ir_v3. All additional existing support-module blobs used by overlay/path/acquisition must be pinned to their bytes at pre_protocol_head in a preregistration receipt before frozen-48 source execution. If an integration requires a scientific/support semantic code change, stop and freeze a new protocol amendment before any held-out source read.
scope_and_minimality.support_module_rule: Historical observability algorithms may be reused only byte-identically from pre_protocol_head. Adapter code may route inputs/outputs but may not alter build_overlay, build_path_observability, acquisition semantics, anchor semantics, case-status semantics, or witness-precondition semantics.
